data.title: Bloom Energy Hits the Road with ESPN College Football Campus Tour to Bring the Power Conversation to Communities Nationwide
data.description: In San Jose, California, Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) is partnering with ESPN College Football Campus Tour to embark on a season-long journey to spark discussions on the future of power at various college campuses nationwide. The initiative will fuse the energy of college football with community interaction and backing emergency response programs. The tour kicks off on September 12 in College Station, Texas, during the Arizona State versus Texas A&M game. Bloom Energy will be a prominent participant throughout the tour.

data.title: EA SPORTS™ NHL® 27 Now Available Worldwide With 32 Authentic Arena Atmospheres and True-to-Life Team Playbooks
data.description: In Redwood City, California, Electronic Arts Inc. has officially released EA SPORTS™ NHL® 27 globally for PlayStation®5 and Xbox Series X|S. The game offers fans the opportunity to get ready for the upcoming 2026-27 NHL® regular season with enhanced levels of realism. NHL 27 showcases all 32 arenas with genuine team atmospheres, tailored presentations that mirror each team's characteristics, a revamped broadcast package, and introduces a fresh commentary pairing of John Buccigross and Darren Pang. This release has been highly anticipated by fans.

data.title: Anchorage Digital enables institutional access to Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin, allowing holders to mint, redeem, and stake the stablecoin.
data.description: A federally chartered crypto bank in the United States has announced that institutional clients will now have the ability to hold, mint, redeem, and stake the Frgmnt’s fUSD stablecoin on its custody platform. This move opens up new opportunities for clients to engage with the stablecoin within the banking sector, with the bank providing the necessary infrastructure for these activities. This development marks a significant step in the integration of digital assets into traditional financial services, catering to the growing demand for such services in the market.

data.title: CICC Participates in the 11th Belt and Road Summit in Hong Kong
data.description: On September 9, 2026, the 11th Belt and Road Summit commenced in Hong Kong, organized by the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) and the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC). CICC (China International Capital Corporation Limited), a key partner, participated in the event. CICC's President, Wang Shuguang, addressed a thematic session during the summit.

data.title: Senate Republicans Introduce Clarity Act Changes Ahead Of Key Vote
data.description: Ahead of an upcoming vote, Senate Republicans have revised the Clarity Act, a bill aimed at regulating the crypto market structure. However, in order for the bill to pass, Democrat support is crucial. The proposed changes are expected to be discussed further in the coming week as the Senate prepares for a vote on the bill. This move reflects the current political dynamics in the Senate where bipartisan cooperation is needed to secure the necessary votes for the bill's passage.

data.title: Tesla Semi Gets Boost From $6 Diesel; Morgan Stanley Says Earnings Potential 'Underappreciated'
data.description: Morgan Stanley believes that the recently launched Tesla Semi truck will significantly contribute to earnings growth over the next 15 years. The firm views the potential of the Tesla Semi as underestimated, especially considering the current $6 cost of diesel. This positive outlook on the earnings potential of the Tesla Semi was highlighted in a recent article on Investor's Business Daily.
